_comment: Starter vocabulary pack. Deliberately small per IMPLEMENTATION.md (Phase 2 grows this from real session evidence). Calibrated to darktable 5.4.1. v1.6.0: removed expo_+0.5 / expo_-0.5 — replaced by the parameterized 'exposure' entry in expressive-baseline (RFC-021 / ADR-077..080). v1.11.0 (RFC-039 / #137): wb_kelvin_delta moved here from expressive-baseline so starter entries can compose it for camera-aware WB; wb_warm_subtle and look_neutral reauthored to compose wb_kelvin_delta.

entries.name: wb_kelvin_delta
entries.description: WB Kelvin / tint UX wrapper (#102). Same temperature module as the temperature entry, but exposes photographic units instead of raw RGB coefficients. 2 axes: --param kelvin_delta=V (range [-3000, 3000]; positive = warmer) and --param tint_delta=V (range [-200, 200]; positive = magenta-shifted). Linear approximation: red_coeff *= 1 + kelvin_delta * 0.0001, blue_coeff inverse, green_coeff *= 1 + tint_delta * 0.0001. Daily-use accurate; not chromatic-adaptation-perfect. RFC-039 / #131 made apply path camera-aware: at non-zero delta, shifts are relative to the target raw's camera-default WB read via rawpy.

entries.name: wb_warm_subtle
entries.description: Warm white balance, subtle. Reauthored RFC-039 / #137 to compose wb_kelvin_delta with a fixed +500K shift; camera-portable.

entries.name: look_neutral
entries.description: Neutral L2 look — exposure + warm-subtle WB baseline. Reauthored RFC-039 / #137 to compose wb_kelvin_delta (no shift at default); camera-portable.
